thermal.ground_vent_accounting: Thermal reactor >=10% rated; house raw thermal Q; ventilated heat equals Q + cabin cold heat; compressor electricity = f*Qvent, cooler electric = Qcold/COP, raw reactor required for both electric draws >=(Pcool+Pcomp)/0.75; run power Qrun=max(10%*Prated,(Pcool+f*Qcold)/(.75-f)), Qrun<=Prated; vent capacity=derate*Prated; no double count of compressor/cooler electricity in Qvent because extracted from Qrun and returned as heat. No external separate 25–300kW sink required in ground-vent mode. Existing installed cooler electric and aux bus caps still apply ONLY to cooler electrical draw, compressor is a separate already-existing tipjet compressor bus; new compressor power tap geometry remains unqualified.

DO NOT FEED INTO ANY GATE. Round 5 explicitly sources rotor heat from a SEPARATE Venus-kit 100–230MW D–He3 house reactor, NOT from this idle torch hypothesis; do not credit this sensitivity in gates.
idle_tipjet_heat.evidence: PSS/PFRC is conceptual 1–10MW and related 2023 analysis cites RF-recirculation losses and no inherent plasma self-heating. No 0.5–3% GW-class stable off-nominal power or exhaust-free rotor gas heating demonstration. Heat-pipe/NTP exchangers establish real temperature, material, pressure-drop and fatigue constraints, not the ~MW/kg mass of a 2226 hot mast.
